Iron ore in structural decline – BHP, RIO, FMG face margin compression; BHP reportedly exploring strategic options
Gold sector resilient: Forrestania joins 2Moz club, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M, Larvotto strikes gold-antimony-tungsten in NSW
Santos gas 'cartel' narrative intensifies; Hormuz Strait escalation keeps oil elevated
Property sector at inflection: home buyer sentiment collapses, NZ house crash returns, 'GFC moment' narrative gains traction

sectors.trend: Iron ore in freefall ('drowning, not waving'); BHP exploring strategic options. Gold miners counter-cyclical strength with multiple ASX discoveries and M&A activity. Gas sector under regulatory and geopolitical stress.
sectors.implications: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore weakness. Overweight gold names (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX, FOR.AX, AUK.AX, LRV.AX) on safe-haven demand and discovery pipeline. Monitor STOL.AX on gas cartel narrative.

sectors.trend: Big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) falling as oil-driven inflation rekindles RBA rate-hike expectations. Property 'GFC moment' raises NPL concerns. Super fraud crackdown and ATO enforcement add regulatory noise.
sectors.implications: Short-term headwind on CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX from rate-hike repricing and property credit risk. Watch for NPL guidance in upcoming earnings. Super sector (HUB.L, PPT.AX) benefits from fraud crackdown narrative.

sectors.trend: Oil hovering near US$100 on Hormuz Strait escalation and Middle East conflict. Santos gas cartel narrative creates regulatory overhang. India crude benchmark tops $100.
sectors.implications: Positive for upstream oil (WDS.AX, WES.AX, XRO.AX) but inflationary pressure hurts rate-sensitive sectors. STOL.AX faces reputational and regulatory risk. LNG exporters (GAS.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from elevated pricing.

sectors.trend: Qantas $35M payout and jet incident pressure QAN.AX. 102-year-old mall retailer closes 25 stores. Car supply crunch jacks up insurance premiums. Living standards squeeze drives second-job participation.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces cost and operational risk. Consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, IAG.AX) under pressure from affordability squeeze. Insurance (WBC.AX, CGF.AX) sees premium tailwind from vehicle supply crunch.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment at multi-year lows; NZ house crash returns; 'GFC moment' narrative. Mortgage costs driving household stress.
sectors.implications: Defensive posture on REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) and property builders (MPL.AX, WBC.AX exposure). Monitor RBA mortgage data and CoreLogic indices closely.

sectors.trend: Tasmanian surgery waiting times breach 1-in-3 threshold; ED attack highlights system strain. Structural underfunding narrative persists.
sectors.implications: Supportive for private health (IAG.AX, HIC.AX) and healthcare services (SGH.AX, CWY.AX) as public system gaps widen. Long-term tailwind for CSL.AX on global demand.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Oil at $100 and Hormuz risk keep inflation elevated, constraining RBA easing and pressuring rate-sensitive sectors (banks, REITs, property). Iron ore weakness drags index via BHP/RIO weight. Gold and energy provide partial offset. QAN.AX and consumer names face idiosyncratic headwinds. Expect volatility around RBA communications and Middle East developments.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Structural iron ore decline, property sector stress, and living standards squeeze cap upside. Gold, healthcare, and energy remain relative outperformers. A property correction could trigger a broader risk-off episode. RBA policy path hinges on oil-driven inflation vs. growth slowdown. Super fraud crackdown and ATO enforcement add regulatory tailwinds for compliant large-caps.
